name: BSP_Plane_GetGroundContactOwner
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_plane_ground_ops, read-only analysis. __fastcall(unit), Ghidra body 006049F0-00604A02, RET 0. Returns unit+BF4h when unit+BF8h is non-zero and 0 otherwise (006049F0 CMP byte [ECX+BF8h],0 / 006049F7 JZ 00604A00 / 006049F9 MOV EAX,[ECX+BF4h]). This pair establishes unit+BF8h as the ground-contact flag and unit+BF4h as the object the plane rests on; 007DB680 calls it twice at 007DC038 and 007DC043 to scale the arrestor wire by the deck length owner+B4h.
